name: IDX WhatsApp channel (owned send path)
description: Project-owned WhatsApp DM channel on a verified outbound gate. No credentials in this package; the Cloud API send path stays off unless the plugin config enables it, and the repo configures it nowhere.

dmPolicy.description: Only allowlist is supported. Any other value, or none, drops every inbound.

allowFrom.description: Phone numbers allowed to write to the assistant. Missing, empty or any malformed entry drops every inbound.

groupPolicy.description: Accepted for the repo baseline; this channel handles direct messages only.

configWrites.description: Accepted for the repo baseline; chat can never change config.

selfChatMode.description: Accepted so an existing config validates; read by no code in this package (transport item).

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp (IDX owned send path)
whatsapp.description: Claims channel id whatsapp in place of the stock plugin, which must stay out of the plugin set (allow-list form, or plugins.deny where the stock plugin is installed).
